**Security bypasses:**
- Kavach SDK (all 9 check flags)
- Jailbreak detection
- Anti-debugging
- Anti-hooking / dylib enumeration
- Harmful app detector
- Developer mode detector
- Runtime manipulation detector
- Network proxy/VPN monitor
- App Attest graceful fallback

**Identity spoofing:**
- IDFV (identifierForVendor)
- Device serial number (keychain)
- Fraud metadata collector
- Longhorn device fingerprint
- Weblab automation detection

**Floating overlay (⚡ FAB):**
- Live log of every hook that fires
- 🔄 Reset & Spoof — wipes all app data, cookies, keychain, caches, generates fresh IDFV + serial
- ℹ️ Device Info — shows spoofed vs real identifiers
